==Skin Trivia==
*The first and second versions of the Level 3, 4 and 5 Default skin were based on ''Team Fortress 2''<nowiki/>'s RED [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Demoman Demoman] as they wore a black vest with a red shirt underneath.
**The original weapon used by the '''Demoman''' is based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Stickybomb_Launcher stickybomb launcher], also from ''Team Fortress 2''.
**The {{Color|Premium|Fortress}} skin is a more direct reference to the RED [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Demoman Demoman].
*The upgrade icons show the '''Demoman''' with a red torso. However, it has a grey torso.
**These upgrade icons were made during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], when the '''Demoman''' still had a red torso.
*Oddly, the '''Demoman''' has no Level 1 icon.
**This was fixed in the [[v1.6.0|Violent Night Update]], however, on the 21st of March 2023, the upgrade icon would be removed.
*The {{Color|Basic|Military}} skin was in the game before the [[v1.6.0|Violent Night Update]], however, due to a bug it was unobtainable.
*The {{Color|SpringFrenzy|Egg}} skin shares the same yellow egg head design as the [[Zombegg]] enemy.
*The {{Color|Beach}} skin was made by mitzu.<ref>https://x.com/raincoatedd/status/2095908976617726333</ref>

===Roblox Catalog===
*The first and second versions weapon used in game is the {{RLinkC|124126871|Newtrat's Tuskinator}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
